summary: WWW (Wolverine World Wide) is a 90+ year footwear & apparel holding company (Merrell, Saucony, Sweaty Betty, Chaco, Wolverine, Cat, Bates, Harley-Davidson, HYTEST) with a clean disclosure profile despite its -49% drawdown. The drawdown is NOT a fraud/solvency story: FY25 revenue +6.8% to $1,874.3M, gross margin 47.3% (vs 44.3%), diluted EPS $1.14 (vs $0.55), operating profit +54.1% to $150.2M, debt declining $648.0M → $621.7M, $510.5M revolver headroom, no going-concern language, Ernst & Young auditor since AT LEAST 1933 (CLEAN_AUDITOR_TENURE), ICFR effective, no Item 9 disagreements, and routine 10b5-1/code-F insider activity with zero discretionary clustering. The 2025-09-24 Replacement Credit Agreement is verified via the matching 2025-09-30 8-K (Item 1.01). The HONESTY-ALPHA core finding is that the well-known PFAS liability is DISCLOSED COMPREHENSIVELY (PASS, not obscured): 40 PFAS-cadence hits across 10-Ks/10-Qs/8-Ks since 2018, $8.5M Litigation Matters accrual + $26.5M environmental remediation reserve + $8.2M remaining Plainfield Township water cap all explicitly quantified, new Dec 4, 2025 '2025 Suit' from landfill owners proactively disclosed, $1.9M FY25 accrual increase explicit (not buried), and EPA FRS independently corroborates the Tannery / Former Tannery sites named in Note 16. Sperry divestiture (Jan 2024) honestly bridged in DEF 14A. Two MODERATE flags: (C7) HIGH_LIEN_EXPOSURE signal is mechanical (routine senior secured Credit Agreement language) but 10-K does not disclose specific net-total-leverage ratio / covenant headroom, only the SOFR margin grid range; (C8) FY25 operating-improvement headline does not narratively bridge the $16.9M unfavorable environmental-recoveries swing and $9.3M favorable impairment-absence — the reader can't easily reconstruct the like-for-like bridge from MD&A alone. One UNVERIFIABLE (C5): 'no customer >10%' claim is plausible but the available M-sources (megacap_namecheck universe excludes footwear retailers; revenue_concentration is fed-services-only) cannot corroborate or falsify it. Composite 0.286 across 8 claims (5 PASS / 2 MODERATE / 0 SEVERE / 0 RED FLAG / 1 UNVERIFIABLE).
